notes.title: Two new stages! Old Jersey & Labyrinth!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36895661/e9e75e8bd6c203b5211d3e73ff777b281ba260e2.png[/img]
[h1]Patch notes[/h1]
[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Two new stages added! Old Jersey and the Labyrinth![/b]
[*] [b]Old Jersey[/b] - Another classic stage with one platform that moves left and right. A classic indeed. There are a few known bugs with the moving platform, but hey, now we have moving plats as a possible addition!
[*] [b]Labyrinth[/b] - Schmoo took it upon himself to make a sprawling battle royale stage. It’s massive!
[*] [b]Grab visuals overhauled.[/b] Thanks Schmoo!
[*] [b]Visual overhaul to prototype stage backgrounds.[/b] Thanks AGAIN Schmoo!
[*] [b]Slugger AI now recovers more consistently instead of deciding not to recover at all very consistently :)[/b]
[*] [b]Added codes for stage select[/b] to make it a little more clear whether a stage is Classic mode [CL], Arena [AR], Battle Royale [BR], and/or Jump Cancel mode [JC].
[*] [b]Focus dashes now have 15 frames of invulnerability rather than 10.[/b] For reference, the total animation is 20 frames long.
[*] Fixed an input error where keyboard users couldn’t roll from the ledge.
[*] Minor bug fixed where you couldn’t walk off of edges if you transitioned from walk to run.
[*] Fixed a bug where players who were eliminated wouldn’t have their items despawn (for example, Artist’s shark would never go away).[/list]
[h3]Artist[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Cloud no longer gives focus back when landing on it.[/b] Probably Artist recovery still deserves more nerfs, but it’s a start.[/list]
[h3]Slugger[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Added a visual indicator to the Bassball and arrow indicator that flashes when the ball is about to despawn.[/b][/list]
[h3]Full patch notes here[/h3]
https://docs.google.com/document/d/16LziGiOmpIVzc5mi0SJLsHqpmO6e-bIW_V4dQ045z-A/edit#heading=h.9vsh9rjz3zik

notes.title: Slayers is FREE TO PLAY!!
notes.notes:
[h1]Free to play is here![/h1]
[h3]Here's a quick snapshot of what's in the game and what's on the horizon.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36895661/6f54a66e3ad885a6d7cdae312691c4cb7a20bc50.png[/img]

[h1]Founder's Pack[/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1721670/SLAYERS_FOR_HIRE__Founders_Pack 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36895661/d7f0f7fb42af17dd48d252617b5830ec35742595.png[/img]

Now that we're F2P, we also have a Founder's Pack for sale with cosmetics as the main reward for buying one. Three are currently implemented, with three more on the way. If you already bought the game on Steam, you already own a Founder's pack! Thanks for your early support! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36895661/d715ca721c167ebe63f7ae6f66876d5c96ae5e65.png[/img]

[h1]State of the Game[/h1]
[h3]The Dragon[/h3]
The bad news is that our big boye is still in development. He's been the bane of my existence this last year if I'm being honest. We've put a ton of work into him and have had to scrap or redo quite a lot. At some point, we tabled development on him to focus on Battle Royale and the Slayer. If we didn't, we'd either have gone broke or gone crazy. He's still coming, but ultimately we refuse to release a version of him that is anything less than fun to play as [i]and[/i] versus. Who knew putting a playable boss character in a platform fighter would be so hard? After the Slayer releases, we're returning to developing him.

[h3]The Slayer[/h3]
Honestly this character is what I'm most excited for in all of Slayers history. The concept behind them is customization and weapon classes. Think Dark Souls, Monster Hunter, or most 3D action RPG's, but put into a fighting game. Once we have their base animations finished, we'll be able to push out new weapon classes at a genuinely rapid pace. We'll also be able to put out *tons* of unique weapons that each play separately from each other. I've been so excited about this character, and it won't be long now before they're out.

As always, here are the patch notes in full: https://docs.google.com/document/d/16LziGiOmpIVzc5mi0SJLsHqpmO6e-bIW_V4dQ045z-A/edit#heading=h.vn7kcrnquhg1

Til next time, Slayers! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36895661/1f55a4573dd4b3d385b235ceea21956a427ab247.png[/img]

notes.title: Development Roadmap
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36895661/1f55a4573dd4b3d385b235ceea21956a427ab247.png[/img]
[h2]Hey there![/h2]
Some of you may have noticed we've been pushing out updates quietly lately. There's a lot of experimental stuff now in the game and a lot of improvements/changes from when you likely last saw the game. There's still much more to come, so without further ado let's look at some of the content on the horizon.
[h2][August 2021] The Return of Free to Play[/h2]
We always planned to make the game free to play. We sold the game on Steam to help support development during Early Access, but at this point we're ready to prioritize making it as open for new players to jump in as possible again.

[b]If you already own the game[/b] - Thank you and congratulations! You're now the owner of a [b]Founder's Pack[/b]! We're still working on implementing this into the game, but this will come with a handful of goodies. Current plans are to bundle a handful of cosmetics, an in-game Founder title, and some stuff associated with our next character, which brings me to...

[h2][September 2021] The Next Playable Character[/h2]
We've been hard at work on many things, but primarily on a character idea we think is going to be a major game changer - [b]The Slayer[/b]. This character is designed around customization, both in terms of fashion and gameplay.

The explanation I've gone to is to describe them as a Dark Souls character. They'll have weapon classes they can equip and several weapons within each weapon class to unlock. There's a ton of stuff we have developed and planned for each weapon class, but the overall idea is to make each weapon feel like a unique character with the wild game design you've come to expect from SLAYERS. Within each weapon you'll be able to prioritize which combination of attacks you prefer, what type of stats you find suit your playstyle best (speed? range? power? a e s t h e t i c s ? )

There are a lot of reasons why we're excited about the Slayer, but the main one is that we can add significant gameplay content at a [i]much[/i] faster pace with them.

We'll also be adding a bit of a UI update alongside the Slayer, but that's another story.

We still plan on creating original characters alongside the new weapon classes, which brings me to the plan for our original roster.

[h2][November 2021 & Beyond] The Original Roster[/h2]
We have a very significant amount of work done on the Dragon, but he's been a massive pain to get to a place where he feels fun to play as and against, without sacrificing our promise of making him feel like playing as a Dark Souls boss. We're getting there, but he got put on the backburner while we were developing Battle Royale and the Slayer. Once those are tuned up, it's back to the Dragon.

But not just the Dragon, the Boxer is planned to be wrapped up in parallel alongside him. The Archer, Ninja, and Jim Jam Flim Flam are after that.

Things are subject to change as we go, but that's the plan and timeline at the moment. 

[h3]Happy slayin, slayers.[/h3]

notes.title: Been a while.
notes.notes:
[h1]They say not to release updates on a Friday night, but here we are.[/h1]

[url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/16LziGiOmpIVzc5mi0SJLsHqpmO6e-bIW_V4dQ045z-A/edit#heading=h.nlils9ccrgeq]Full patch notes here (formatted properly)[/url]

It's been... too long, but we're back to releasing updates. There are many changes we  aren't including in this, and many things we ARE including are still a bit rough, but we need feedback on this stuff. We're excited to be back (me most of all) and I think you're gonna like what we're putting out today and over the next few months. It's gonna be a fun ride. Hopefully there's a romantic sunset involved.

Some patch notes (probably not formatted correctly):

[h1]0.10.0.4 - Been a while. - July 9, 2021[/h1]
[h2]New Game Modes (WIP):[/h2]
[list][*] Battle Royale (very WIP)
[*] Team Battle Royale 
[*] Arena Deathmatch
[*] Team Arena Deathmatch[/list]
[h2]General[/h2]
[list][*] [b]Public and private lobby functionality added[/b] - You can now mark your online lobby as public or private. Private lobbies require the code, but public lobbies can be joined by anyone who clicks “Join Random.”
[*] [b]Max player count up from 6 to 16[/b] - Gonna be honest, this might not even work but we need to push it to get playtesting on how many people can play the game at once.
[*] [b]Movement rework[/b] - We wanted to make the game feel more like a platformer and strip away some of the legacy platform fighter restrictions, like locking you into runturn. Start and stop on a dime! Should help keyboard players a lot.
[*] [b]Variable jump height[/b] - Holding jump for different amounts of time will let you rise varying amounts. Sounds crazier than it actually is.
[*] [b]Jump cancelable attacks[/b] - Landing an attack allows you to jump and cancel all lag. We have other options we’re going to test too, but for now this one felt the best.
[*] [list][*] [i](Also added more hitlag on all moves to make the cancel window feel better and for the extra CHONK)
[*] [*] ((Also added a 2 SDI cap per hitlag event so that you can’t do Wizzrobe TAS escapes every time you get jabbed))[/i][/list]
[*] [b]Ground bounces[/b] - Missing a tech against a downwards attack will often bounce you back up into the air
[*] [b]Death by wall [/b]- Missing a tech at high knockback will now lose you a stock. Mainly seen in arena and battle royale maps, where you’d otherwise never be able to die.
[*] [b]Roll and spotdodge reworked[/b] - You’re now invincible for the whole animation, but blocking a move in this state puts you back into focus. Offense got buffed, so defense got buffed too. Lets you wiggle out of pressure more safely, or you can greed by risking a a wavedash to take your turn back faster.
[*] [b]Projectile despawning[/b] - Hitting a character out of a projectile spawn will despawn the projectile in most cases. 
[*] [list][*] [i]Projectiles in general can be dealt with better now. Spy’s missile in particular should be nerfed by this.[/i][/list]
[*] [b]Respawn visual overhaul[/b] - You’ll see what I mean once you get in game.
[*] [b]New shader & lighting overhaul[/b] - Game looks nicer. Gold skins actually look like gold instead of just another yellow skin.
[*] [b]Hitlag smear overhaul[/b] - Taking a page from Darkstalkers, we now allow moves with smears to freeze frame on a more flattering frame rather than the extremely stretched out frames they usually connect on.
[*] [b]Quantum backend upgraded to v2 [/b]- Doesn’t mean much for you guys, but this took a ton of work. It enables us to do higher player counts, though we’ll have to see how high people can go without chugging. We’ve done 12 internally without frame drops, but who knows.
[*] [b]Low knockback hitstun reworked[/b] - It used to be if you landed during low knockback moves, all your hitstun was canceled. This made a lot of weird things unsafe on hit at low percents. Just legacy platform fighter things.
[*] [b]Air throws sped up[/b] - I got tired of waiting on these things to finish their animations, so I made them play like two times faster.[/list]
[h2]Stages[/h2]
[list][*] [b]New stages![/b]
[olist][*] The Beat (arena map, WIP)
[*] [*] Battle Royale Prototype
[*] [*] Octagon Arena Prototype[/olist]
[*] More prototypes coming real soon because of Schmoo’s awesome new stage builder (internal use only for now)
[*] [b]General stage stuff[/b] - Cameras and lighting reworked on all stages to work better
[*] [b]The Bay[/b] - Altered the stage geometry so that you don’t get spiked if you’re hit while holding the ledge
[/list]

[h2]Artist[/h2]
[list][*] [b]Ink trail visual update![/b] Schmoo is amazing. Oh, and you travel faster on it.
[*] Buffed the cloud :) It’s bigger, lasts longer, and comes out faster
[*] Improved the recovery on tree and shark summons slightly[/list]

[h2]Slugger[/h2]
[list][*] [b]Bassball reworked[/b] - Lifetime increased to 10 seconds or something very long now. Can now recall the ball back to Slugger (a little buggy right now, this is a WIP)
[*] Lower short hop jump height (1.7 to 1.5)
[*] Forward and back air buffed to be kill moves again[/list]

[h2]Spy[/h2]
[list][*] [b]Tons of changes.[/b] Jab might be the only move that didn’t receive at least some changes.
[*] Walljump improved in height and horizontal distance travelled.
[*] Gravity grenade overhauled to be more consistent and usable. Behaves more consistently in how it pulls you in, lasts longer (60 frames, was 45), and activation can be canceled very quickly now.
[*] Missile nerfed in size, can’t dismount as quickly now either. Still pretty strong, but not as spammable.
[*] Tank is smaller, but recovers faster. Also doesn’t have a reversible hitbox, so following up on it is more reliable.
[*] Tommy gun slide and uzi forward attacks both sped up a little.
[*] Removed the cannon torch hitbox. It was mostly added as a joke, but it felt awkward and confusing in use.
[*] Added more pushback from shotgun, because why not.
[*] Bombs from the air bomb drop (down air) last longer/fall farther. Maybe now people will stop complaining about it being unusable (doubtful).
[*] Trident now hits upwards more on the first 2 hits and is more 
[*] Jetpack (air strong up) hitbox reworked to only hit at the start of the move, but now spikes. [/list]

...And probably much more that didn’t get catalogued. I think I got most of it though.

notes.title: Patch 0.8.10 - Ranked leaderboards! And a bunch of other stuff, too!
notes.notes:
Surprise! There's actually [b]three[/b] things to announce today!

First off, the game is on sale! [b]SLAYERS is 10% off for the next week![/b] Yahoo!

[b]Second, we're implementing ranked leaderboards as of today!![/b] φ(*￣0￣) Please note that this is essentially version 0.1 of the ranked mode. It's not got sets built in yet, and the formula itself is more or less untested beyond what we could do internally. I might make a vlog about it, but just know that ranked is going to continue to go through big changes over the course of the next few months, so please be patient with us. 

That said, I think this is going to make the game a lot more fun! There are 9 skill tiers, and once your 6 placement matches complete you'll be tossed into a tier. The ranks are probably a bit too volatile atm, but we really just need data to see how well my simulations are matching up with people's experiences. Good luck on the boards, people!

Finally, we've got a bunch of other stuff coming out with this patch! Here are a few things off the top of my head:
[list][*]There's a pretty big backend overhaul to the UI that should make everything more stable
[*]A fancy new results screen has been added in post-match
[*]Color costumes are selectable in character select now! Along with previews of the character models!
[*]The controls saving bug is [i]I think[/i] fixed. Let me know if it's not and we'll get back on it!
[*]In game visibility should be improved yet again. Probably won't be the last time this gets tweaked, but each time should help the game be easier to read :)
[*]Some netcode tweaks got made thanks to our friends at Quantum. This will probably also continue getting tweaked, but I think this should be an improvement to the stability and feel of the netcode.
[*]Focus is nerfed to be more punishable on whiff.
[*]...and a bunch of other stuff, too! I need to get back into the habit of making full patch notes. Next time![/list]
[i][b]PHEW! [/b][/i]That was a lot to cover! But one last thing... There are still more announcements to look out for over the next few weeks. This wasn't "the big one." ːsteammockingː Stay tuned, Slayers. And as always, thanks for your support!!

Alsoooo don't forget, the submission deadline for the combo video contest is May 7th! Get your vids in and you could win upwards of $100! [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1070150/partnerevents/edit/2190381723579073812]More information on that here.[/url]
